_description: NIIT 3.8% fires when MAGI exceeds the $200k single threshold and the withdrawal is from a taxable account.
_rationale: Single, age 60, Florida (0% state). $1M taxable account, no other income, $300k living expenses, no growth. Withdrawal w solves w·(1 − 0.15) − 0.038·(w − 200000) = 300000 → 0.812w = 292400 → w = 360,098.52. Federal LTCG = 54,014.78; State LTCG = 0 (Florida); NIIT = 0.038 × (360,098.52 − 200,000) = 6,083.74. Total tax = 60,098.52. Net cash flow = 0. Balance year 1 = 1,000,000 − 360,098.52 = 639,901.48.
name: NIIT Trigger
